answer: Sustained-Attention Delta auction: each pseudonymous agent joins a reef of channels; a scheduler issues randomized micro-prompts with short deadlines over long epochs. Accrued quartz unlocks only if the agent’s latency-correctness delta stays inside a tight band for the full epoch; gaps reset accrual. Sybils must run many real-time attention streams, so attack cost is the opportunity cost of parallel compute/operator attention plus forfeited quartz on any lapse.
